A FEW LITTLE DETAILS

Good questions.

Here’s what to know
before making it your own.

Can I download HeyNotch today?

These previews show the version in development. A public installer is not available yet, and the public source may not include every preview feature. You can explore the project and follow its progress on GitHub.

Explore project source ↗
Does it start recording calls automatically?

No. Meeting reminders can notice microphone or camera activity and offer to transcribe. Recording begins only after you choose Start and grant the required macOS permissions. You control when a session starts and stops.

Where do my words go?

Dictation uses local Whisper. Optional AI text processing sends the text you choose to the provider you select. Meeting-derived task drafts stay out of AI processing; saving a task uses your selected Apple Reminders list.

Do I need an AI subscription?

Local dictation does not need a Claude, OpenAI, or OpenRouter key. If you want optional AI text processing, add your own provider API key and select a model. Model access and any usage charges depend on your provider account.

How does the task board work with Reminders?

Choose a Reminders list to see its tasks in the notch. Doing is progress saved locally on this Mac. Moving a task to Done updates its completion in Reminders. Your existing list remains the home for the task.

What can a connected agent access?

Each connection is limited to the task lists you select and the read or write access you grant. It does not expose provider API keys or meeting recordings. You can revoke a connection in HeyNotch’s Agent access settings.

Is HeyNotch an Apple app?

HeyNotch is an independent, personal fork of boring.notch. It is open source under GPL-3.0 and is not affiliated with Apple. macOS and MacBook are Apple trademarks.
